name: MiniMax M Plan
notes: Subscription with 5-hour and weekly usage limits and no per-token prices; each model carries the list prices of its MiniMax API pay-as-you-go equivalent, so Cost is what a request would cost there. Takes an M Plan API key (sk-cp-...), which is not interchangeable with a MiniMax API key although the base URL is the same. Global region only. The M Plan docs name only M3.1 Flash as the text model; the model list comes from MiniMax Code's packages/config/src/minimax-model-catalog.ts, which offers M3.1 Flash and M3 at 512K context on the plan and M2.7 and M2.7 highspeed at 200K. Caching is automatic prefix matching, so cacheMarkerLimit 0 keeps the gateway from adding markers, as for MiniMax API. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/). M3.1-Flash and M3 take the 1,000,000 context of the MiniMax API docs (models.dev lists the same for the coding plan); no doc caps the plan lower.

upstreamModels.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
upstreamModels.notes: 512K context on the plan. Prices are MiniMax API list prices for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash; cache write is not published and is set to the input price, since caching is automatic. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev.

upstreamModels.name: MiniMax-M3
upstreamModels.notes: 512K context on the plan. Not named in the M Plan docs; listed by MiniMax Code's model catalog. Prices are MiniMax API list prices for MiniMax-M3 at the up-to-512K tier with the 'permanent 50% off' applied; cache write is not published and is set to the input price, since caching is automatic. maxOutputTokens comes from models.dev.
